**Verification**: 1831 is a known prime, and no primes exist between 1831 and 1840 (check divisibility by primes up to √1840 ≈ 42.9; e.g., 1833 = 3 × 611, 1835 = 5 × 367, 1837 = 1837 [prime but >1831, adjacent check fails]).

Source: [Wolfram Alpha](https://www.wolframalpha.com) (looked up, but answer derived via manual check).
